stories.title: Have Ordinary Users Become Negative Assets of AI? Exploring the Hidden Impact of Mass Users on Artificial Intelligence Development
stories.description: In the digital business landscape, a widely recognized core principle is that "Only revenue-generating users are valuable" — a foundational concept that shapes customer segmentation, resource allocation, and growth strategy for enterprises across e-commerce, SaaS, digital content, and subscription-based industries. This user value framework emphasizes that audiences who directly or indirectly drive measurable, sustainable revenue streams for a business deliver tangible operational and strategic value, distinguishing high-impact user groups from non-monetizing traffic that fails to contribute to bottom-line performance. For marketers, product managers, and business decision-makers, prioritizing the cultivation, retention, and monetization of revenue-generating users helps optimize ROI, reduce unnecessary operational costs, and align product iteration and marketing efforts with core business goals of long-term profitability. This insight into user value assessment serves as a critical guiding metric for data-driven business optimization, customer lifecycle management, and scalable revenue growth in competitive digital markets.
